planets.name: WASP-12 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-12 with a 1.09-day year, found in 2008.

text.card: WASP-12 b crosses its star every 1.09 days and is 2 Jupiter radii across, found in 2008.
text.introduction: WASP-12 b transits WASP-12 every 1.09 days and is 2 Jupiter radii across. Orbit and size follow Leonardi et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname LEONARDI_ET_AL__2024): pl_orbper 1.091418901, pl_radj 1.965, pl_bmassj 1.47

quotes.title: WASP-12b
quotes.card: WASP-12b is a hot Jupiter orbiting the star WASP-12, discovered in April of 2008, by the SuperWASP planetary transit survey.
quotes.introduction: The planet takes only a little over one Earth day to orbit its star, in contrast to about 365.25 days for the Earth to orbit the Sun.
